fullContentHtml:
CIPET Admit Card 2025 – Full Details

Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering & Technology (CIPET) has released the admit card for the Diploma / Post Diploma & PG Diploma Courses Admission 2025 for which the online application process has started from 07 February 2025. Any candidate who is interested to fill this form, they should check eligibility, age limit & must read the Full Notification Before applying for the CIPET Admit Card 2025. Those Candidates Are Interested in the following recruitment can apply online from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 February 2025
  • Last Date : 29 May 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 May 2025
  • Exam Date : 08 June 2025
  • Admit Card Available : 04 June 2025

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 100/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Download Admit Card
  • Apply Online
  • Download Information Brochure
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is CIPET Admit Card 2025?

CIPET Admit Card 2025 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
